PR (cited in the notes as #22186): fix: have argocd server pass the AppLabelKey and VerifySignature for proper caching [closed]
Argocd server runs a manifest generation operation when a new app is requested for creation. This manifest gen operation goes through repo server and is cached but this cache is useless for future attempts because most of the time the next calls for the same manifest generation request from app-controller would usually have the appLabelKey set causing a cache miss.
